The third selection pertains to the NO regulation Tier level (Figure 12). The default setting estimates X results based on Tier level 2, but the user can modify this to Tier 0, 1, 2 and 3. The fourth drop-down list corresponds to the main propulsion type (Figure 13), which is dependent on the vessel type, as shown on Table 4.
